claim: In the matching retail DLL, Player.TransitStateAfterAnm_AutoRun (0x06004EC7) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 712-byte body. It loads Ring.venueSetting and TargetPlIdx Player, stores AutoRunWaza=animator.SkillSlotID, and initializes a local decision flag to zero. When ringKind is neither raw 1 nor raw 3 and Zone is zero, it derives a ring-area value from target.PlPos, selects PlDir through an exact branch graph over target existence, target.PlDir, CurrentSkill.hitDmgType_Single and MatchMisc.IsArea_UpperTriangles, then calls Ring.mGetOctagonInSideCrossLine(target.PlPos.x,target.PlPos.y,Ring.colData_InsideRing,Player.Way2pb2[PlDir],ref AutoRunDest). If that call succeeds and target converts true, it computes sqrt(target.PlPos.x^2 + target.PlPos.y^2). A distance below 2.0833332538604736 sets the local decision flag; values below 2.9166665077209473 also enter an exact parity/direction check using (ringArea & 1), optionally XOR 1 when hitDmgType_Single is nonzero, and target.PlDir raw 0 or 3 to possibly set the same flag. If the flag is nonzero, the method ChangeState(56), stores AutoRunStep=0, requests raw BasicAnm 44 + MatchData.AnmOfsTbl_3Dir[PlDir], stores host animator.AnmHostPlayer=PlIdx and, when target converts true, target.animator.AnmHostPlayer=TargetPlIdx, then returns. If the flag is zero and target converts true, hitDmgType_Single nonzero first copies target.PlDir into this.PlDir, then this.ChangeState(10), target.ChangeState(47), this.animator.StartAnm(7), and this.animator.StartOpponentAnmM(TargetPlIdx,8,TargetPlIdx), then returns. FACT-0048 pins the exact caller boundary: raw AnimeEnd 9 dispatches to this helper at TransitStateAfterAnm IL+0x03A6.
